LanguageData.LP_Style_Archery.label: archery
LanguageData.LP_Style_Archery.description: Ranged weapon shot hit chance ×1.08, range +2 cells (weapon shots only, not abilities; thrown weapons don't count).
LanguageData.LP_Style_Defense.label: defense
LanguageData.LP_Style_Defense.description: While wearing an outer or middle layer whose sharp armor is ≥ 40%, sharp and blunt armor +8%.
LanguageData.LP_Style_Dueling.label: dueling
LanguageData.LP_Style_Dueling.description: When the main hand is a one-handed melee weapon (mass under 2.5 kg) and no off-hand is in use, melee damage ×1.2.
LanguageData.LP_Style_GreatWeapon.label: great weapon fighting
LanguageData.LP_Style_GreatWeapon.description: With a two-handed melee weapon (mass over 2.5 kg), melee damage ×1.15 and melee cooldown ×0.95.
LanguageData.LP_Style_Protection.label: protection
LanguageData.LP_Style_Protection.description: When an adjacent ally (surrounding 8 cells) is attacked, the attacker's hit chance ×0.85 (melee and ranged).
LanguageData.LP_Style_Interception.label: interception
LanguageData.LP_Style_Interception.description: When an ally within 3 cells takes outside damage, block 3 + proficiency bonus points of it (down to 0 at least). Once every 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_Style_TwoWeapon.label: two-weapon fighting
LanguageData.LP_Style_TwoWeapon.description: A melee weapon in the pack serves as an off-hand: each normal melee hit has a 30% chance of an extra off-hand strike (damage uses the off-hand multiplier in settings). Right-click a melee weapon on the ground to "take as off-hand". Has no effect with dual-wield mods installed.
LanguageData.LP_Style_BlindFighting.label: blind fighting
LanguageData.LP_Style_BlindFighting.description: Shooting is unaffected by smoke; can see invisible units within 3 cells.
LanguageData.LP_Style_Thrown.label: thrown weapon fighting
LanguageData.LP_Style_Thrown.description: Thrown weapons (grenades, molotovs, EMP grenades, this mod's alchemical throwables) range ×1.3, hit chance ×1.1.
LanguageData.LP_Style_Unarmed.label: unarmed fighting
LanguageData.LP_Style_Unarmed.description: Without a weapon, fist and kick damage ×1.6; unarmed hits have a 20% chance to grab the target for 2 seconds (almost unable to move).
